name: Land Cruiser Prado LJ70
stock_transmission: 5-speed manual (floor); coil-sprung front/rear, part-time 4WD, manual rear diff lock
notes: Sources disagree on exact engine by year - some describe it continuing as a base/cheaper non-turbo (2L) trim alongside KZJ70 through 1996, others say the 2L/2L-T line was phased out by the 1993 1KZ update. 2L-TE used here as a representative engine; sold under various market names (Land Cruiser II, 'Bundera' in Australia).
